sourceOriginChain.materializedFrom: MPFB2 HumanService.create_human with macro_detail_dict derived from the tracked Anny reference
sourceOriginChain.derivationNote: Issue #328: the MPFB2 materializer now derives its macro dict from the tracked Anny reference instead of baking the default human. age=0.15 from the measured head-height fraction (0.160, child band — the MPFB age macro has a real child band 0.0-0.1875, so this is a macro CHILD, not a scaled adult); height=0.569 SOLVED by bake-measure-interpolate so the baked+stripped exported body reaches the reference stature (1.25 m). Macros baked into the basis via TargetService.bake_targets immediately after create_human. #317 face keys (32 targets / 13 mouth), #318 helper strip (19,158->13,380 verts / 36,972->26,756 tris), #321 toigo t-shirt fit (2,700 tris, k-NN weighted to the standard rig) and #323 body-part hiding all ran unchanged. Measured (largest non-garment/non-hidden primitive): largestVisiblePrimitiveSpanM 1.1651 (NOT stature — the torso is hidden under the fitted shirt (#323), so this is a visible-skin span, not the body's height; the shipped body's stature is ~1.241 m), chest 0.6237, waist 0.7660, chest:waist ratio 0.8142. The toigo t-shirt was authored for an adult; its fit on the child is expected loose and was not re-graded. Regenerated 2026-08-11 (#337 resume): merged main (#335) and re-baked with CC0 MakeHuman default eyes (data/eyes/hm08/low-poly, header-verified CC0) fitted pre-#318-strip via HumanService.add_mhclo_asset(asset_type="eyes", material_type="PROCEDURAL_EYES"); eye mesh renamed makeclothes_library_eyes_low_poly_mpfb_<body>_mesh (96 verts / 172 tris), weighted 1.0 to eye.L/eye.R by interpolate_weights (dominant groups eye.L 48 / eye.R 48); #334 hide-mask head-joint bound and #335 casts preserved; iris rotation delta at gaze=1 measured 10-13 mm, 89-94% lateral. Issue #340: re-baked with the eye material consuming the asset's OWN declared .mhmat — brown.mhmat's diffuseTexture brown_eye.png (CC0, 610,817 bytes, git blob bda1b4b0 == upstream main) bound as glTF baseColorTexture via the generic make_material_from_mhmat path; the flat eye baseColor (#337 white / #338 brown) is gone. Eye geometry (96 verts / 172 tris, eye.L/eye.R weights) unchanged; body macros, hide masks, garment fits, footwear and sole grounding re-run identically. textureMode updated procedural_fallback -> authored_or_baked because the eye channel now carries a baked diffuse texture.

sourceNotes: Issue #328 first slice of the transition off Anny-only assets: Anny is the REFERENCE, MPFB2 is the generated body.
gender/muscle/weight/proportions/cupsize/firmness remain MPFB defaults — only age + height are driven by reference measurement this slice.
Exact MADR 0051 §5 landmark match (shoulder, girths, limb lengths) is anny-mpfb-landmark-compare's follow-on; NOT claimed here.
Child topology after strip is the canonical 13,380-vert hm08 basemesh — the same 13,380 the toigo .mhclo indexes.
Issue #333: re-baked on the merged #328 materializer with the #326 lower channel (cargo-pants cover shell) and the #333 footwear channel (toigo_mj_cloth_shoes, sole grounded to body bottom).

Issue #335: re-baked with the #332 upper-garment neck anchor (the fitted t-shirt landed at the child's hip — collar 0.545 H — because the fit maps onto the armature-deformed body; the collar is now anchored to the child's own neck01 joint at 0.836 H, inside the anatomical neck band [0.78, 0.92], and the lower gate re-ran so the pants cover shell reaches the waist) and the #334 hide-mask head-joint clip (no-op on this body — the mask stops well below the head joint). Upper-garment mesh renamed to the makeclothes_library_*_mpfb_<ref> convention. Cast into peds_asthma_parent_anxiety_v1 as the patient; promotionStatus set to promoted_runtime_cast_not_realism_gate_pass (NOT a realism gate pass).

Issue #340: re-baked with the eye material consuming the asset's OWN declared .mhmat — brown.mhmat's diffuseTexture brown_eye.png (CC0, 610,817 bytes, git blob bda1b4b0 == upstream main) bound as glTF baseColorTexture via the generic make_material_from_mhmat path; the flat eye baseColor (#337 white / #338 brown) is gone. Eye geometry (96 verts / 172 tris, eye.L/eye.R weights) unchanged; body macros, hide masks, garment fits, footwear and sole grounding re-run identically. textureMode updated procedural_fallback -> authored_or_baked because the eye channel now carries a baked diffuse texture.

Issue #351 (2026-08-12): re-baked with the wrist/metacarpal limb vocabulary fix in body_param_stage._LIMB_BONE_RE (no-op on the mixamo_unity rail, which has neither bone). The lower cover shell's band selection wrapped the exported A-pose hands — this body's palms are metacarpal-dominant (120+120 outlying verts at |x| up to 0.382 m in the trouser top band) and the regex missed the MPFB standard rig's wrist/metacarpal bones — so the trousers shipped on the hands. The widened vocabulary excludes the palm/wrist faces from the shell band; no trouser vertex is hand-weighted. Measured post-fix: lateral ratio 3.551 -> 1.287 (torso half 0.108 m, max |x| 0.139 m), outside-torso tris 260/2816 -> 153/2636 (all hip flare), leg area 2997 cm2, shirt/trouser overlap 13.4 mm unchanged.
